Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including all schools, adult education, and post-secondary sites with detailed building and site data (Section 2). Robust condition assessments cover building systems, infrastructure, and outdoor facilities, with clear connection to long-term capital planning (Sections 2, 3, 4).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Detailed enrollment projections over 10 years with demographic analysis and housing development data (Section 2). Capacity utilization data by site and grade with explicit discussion of under- and over-utilization and connection to facility actions including new construction and repurposing (Section 2).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle with detailed design guidelines supporting flexible, adaptable learning spaces, specialized program spaces (CTE, SPED, TK), and inclusive facilities (Sections 1.3, 1.4). Facility projects are directly linked to educational goals and program needs, including special education and adult education (Sections 2, 3).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Plan provides data and analysis of outdoor spaces including quads, gathering areas, and landscaping with strategies for improvement such as shade structures and gardens (Sections 1.4, 2). However, districtwide greening and climate resilience framing is present but not fully detailed or comprehensive.

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Plan addresses climate impacts such as extreme weather and air quality with strategies including energy efficiency, water conservation, and resilient design elements (Section 1.5). Climate readiness is a priority theme integrated into planning and design, though detailed multi-risk assessments and site-specific strategies are limited.

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Significant detail on energy use baselines, state requirements (Title 24, ZNE), and comprehensive strategies including electrification, solar, battery storage, and microgrids (Section 1.5). Energy resilience is positioned as a core part of the plan with data-driven targets and integration with climate resilience.

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Comprehensive capital strategy with detailed cost estimates, phased project prioritization, and multiple funding sources including bonds and state programs (Sections 3, 4). Financial planning includes escalation assumptions, contingencies, and alignment with district educational priorities and long-term sustainability.
